source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The old/new message property event was built on a folder notification service to avoid registering a database listener on every folder. This patch deliberately reports junk changes from the UI and SetJunkScoreForMessages filter route. Other direct database writers are not proven covered: the author describes their parsing-only role as current understanding and proposes centralized junk updates as later work. Preserve the explicit route limit when consuming this event; a new oldProperties bag is not a complete database before-image. Static source and historical review evidence only; no new runtime validation.
title: Keep message-update event coverage tied to its actual notification routes
